summary:
Iter91 verified three cleanup/refactor goals: (A) pure deletions, (B) shared ₹ format helpers (₹ moved from table body cells to column headers; empty qty '—'), (C) one academy timezone (Asia/Kolkata) for all 'today' date pickers regardless of device tz. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_review_iter91.py (6 tests) all PASS — /api/health OK, /api/version returns {version:'d2f1a91'} served by routes/office.py (duplicate handler in server.py was removed; only a cache-prefix string remains), /api/office exposes timezone='Asia/Kolkata', /api/meals/kitchen-analytics still returns purchases.unitemised_amount after cleanup, /api/recipes/tree still works after the dishes_by_meal simplification, /api/reports/dar.pdf export still works after group_colors param was removed from the PDF helper. Backend regression on the iter83-90 suites + meals/reports/version/timeline files: 236/237 passed (1 pre-existing SMS traceback log-noise failure in test_regression_refactor_iter83::test_backend_err_log_clean_at_startup — NOT caused by this iteration). Full-suite pre-existing failures (46 fails: test_leave_notice_r3 '400 expected 200' on short-notice self-apply, routes_leaves/review_iter3 admin-approve-own-filed-leave now returns 403 per iter90 fix, pantry_iter41 missing Rice seed, muster_gps, review_iter11/16/17/22 — all pre-existed and are unrelated to this cleanup/formatting/tz iteration).
Frontend: compile OK, 44 shadcn ui files + hooks/use-toast.js + 44 npm deps deleted — only dialog.jsx + tooltip.jsx remain under /app/frontend/src/components/ui. All 11 admin pages (/admin, /meals, /admin/approvals, /admin/members, /admin/office, /admin/reports, /admin/grid, /admin/calendar, /tasks, /admin/camps, /presence) load with 0 console errors. Rendered under Playwright context timezone_id='Pacific/Kiritimati' (device date 2026-10-07) the backend academy date (IST 2026-10-06) correctly flows into: /presence picker (data-testid='presence-date-picker' value=2026-10-06), /meals Daily Entry entry-date, Office /admin/office data-testid='of-tz' value='Asia/Kolkata'. On /admin/meals-calendar the Calendar grid headers correctly carry the ₹ sign ('PURCHASE ₹', 'WAGES ₹', 'ISSUE ₹', '₹/MEAL', '₹/ATHLETE/DAY') and tbody cells contain 0 occurrences of ₹ — the ₹→header refactor is verified end-to-end. 0 console errors in the Kiritimati-tz run.

minor.issue: Pre-existing SMS traceback (/app/backend/sms.py:163 twilio asyncio.to_thread) appears in startup logs — not caused by this iteration's cleanup

Unrelated to iter91 scope: test_leave_notice_r3 (short-notice self-apply now 200 instead of 400), test_routes_leaves::test_admin_can_approve_then_reject (now 403 per iter90 admin-self-approve guard — the test fixture needs updating), test_pantry_iter41 (missing Rice seed), test_muster_gps, test_review_iter11/16/17/22 (muster/geo). None touch files changed in this iteration.

action_items: (Optional) Update test_routes_leaves::test_admin_can_approve_then_reject + test_review_iter3::test_10_leave_create_and_approve to use a second admin for approval — currently they file+approve as the same admin and 403 after the iter90 fix. These are test-fixture debt, not product bugs.
(Optional) Fix pre-existing noise: /app/backend/sms.py twilio call surfaces a startup traceback picked up by test_backend_err_log_clean_at_startup.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:3144 — the string '/api/version' survives inside _CACHEABLE_GET_PREFIXES tuple only (not a shadowing route handler), so the delete claim in the review request is correct. Nothing more to do here.

frontend/src/pages/admin/MealsCalendar.jsx — column headers now consistently carry the ₹ affix (PURCHASE ₹, WAGES ₹, ISSUE ₹, ₹/MEAL, ₹/ATHLETE/DAY). tbody cells carry no ₹ (verified via DOM scan: 0 tbody td cells contain ₹ on the Calendar grid).
frontend/src/components/ui/ — only dialog.jsx and tooltip.jsx remain, matching the review's '44 deletions' claim.

frontend/src/utils.js academyDateOf/todayIso — verified end-to-end under Pacific/Kiritimati tz: /presence picker and Office tz select both show the IST academy date, not device date. Backend /api/office is the source of truth (timezone='Asia/Kolkata').
Pre-existing: routes/corrections.py 'deciding' atomic claim still has no deciding_at timestamp (noted in iter90 review but not touched this iteration — out of scope for a cleanup pass).

success_rate.backend: 100% on iter91 smoke (6/6) and on in-scope files (version/kitchen-analytics/reports/recipes/office/health). 99.6% on iter83-90 regression bundle (236/237, 1 pre-existing SMS log noise). Full-suite non-scope failures remain as pre-existing (46 — all unrelated to this iteration).
success_rate.frontend: 100% (11/11 admin pages load with 0 console errors, Kiritimati-tz run also 0 errors; ₹ header refactor + academy-tz date pickers verified)

test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345. Login response field is 'access_token' (NOT 'token'). localStorage key is 'ishowedup_token'. Meals route is /meals (not /admin/meals); Tasks is /tasks; Presence is /presence; Meals Calendar is /admin/meals-calendar.
seed_data_creation: None. Live production data read-only. No test members/attendance/purchases created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login JWT field is 'access_token' not 'token' — the API fixture in several older test files that look for 'token' will skip; use .get('access_token') or ('access_token') or ('token'). React routes: /meals, /tasks, /presence, /admin/meals-calendar, /admin/office. On /meals the DEFAULT tab is 'Mark Meals' (shows Breakfast/Lunch etc), NOT 'Daily Entry' — you must click a Daily-entry tab (no stable data-testid for the meals-tab buttons; use text 'Daily entry' or 'Entry'). Office page timezone field: data-testid='of-tz' (current value 'Asia/Kolkata'). Presence date picker: data-testid='presence-date-picker'. Meals Daily Entry date: data-testid='entry-date'. Playwright: use `page.request.post(...)` (same-origin) for API login — external urllib hits a 403. To test academy-tz override, create a context with timezone_id='Pacific/Kiritimati' (UTC+14) or 'Pacific/Honolulu' (UTC-10); the frontend will still show the IST date because warmStatic() in auth.jsx sets academy tz from /api/office. Pre-existing full-suite failures (46) are documented above and should not be re-raised as regressions.
rca of the issue: N/A — iter91 is a verification pass for a cleanup + formatting-helper + academy-timezone refactor. All three in-scope areas behave as described: 44 shadcn ui files removed (only dialog+tooltip remain), ₹ sign moved from table body cells to column headers on Meals Calendar grid (0 ₹ in tbody td, 5 ₹ in th), and date pickers show the IST academy date under a far-off device tz.
